display.purpose: Hero headline only. Barlow Condensed 900 italic. Never on section headings.

shadows.name: feature-glow

motion.name: ease-out-quart

motion.name: reveal-enter
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered reveals. translateY 16px → 0. NOT gating visibility — elements are visible by default, transition enhances.

motion.name: stagger-delay
motion.purpose: Stagger offset for list items within a section. Never applied uniformly to entire sections.

narrative.overview:
Precision under pressure. Every element is shaped to tolerance — no excess material, no decorative chrome. The beauty of a forge is that nothing survives the heat that doesn't have to be there. The same discipline applies here: the surface is dark because it's a control room, not because dark looks cool; the accent is orange because it's the exact color of metal at working temperature, not because it's a brand color someone chose from a picker.

The design language derives from the name literally. The hero carries incandescent warmth through radial gradients built in CSS, not borrowed from Unsplash. The dashboard and member area are displayed as showcases of real product technology, positioned the way Resend.com presents its API — as the proof that this gym runs like a system.

Section rhythm is set by generous vertical space and a single 1px rule at rgba(255,255,255,0.06). No alternating background colors, no polygon clip-paths masquerading as identity. The machine has no decorative parts.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black base with subtle blue undertone (#0C0D10) — depth without pure black flatness
Single forge-orange accent used sparingly (≤3 elements per viewport)
DM Mono for all numbers, metrics, and data — monospace signals precision
Barlow Condensed display type — compressed power, literally athletic
Micro-borders (1px, 6% white opacity) as the only separator between surfaces
Flat elevation at rest; box-shadow reserved for one element: the featured plan card

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: #FF5E1A appears on ≤3 elements per viewport. It earns attention by scarcity. If a section contains more than three forge-orange touches, remove the least important one.

rules.name: The Muted-Is-Not-Body Rule
rules.body: #4A4D5F (text-muted) fails WCAG AA at body size. It is only permitted for uppercase labels ≥14px or purely decorative elements. Never for sentences, paragraphs, or any text the user needs to read.

rules.name: The Uppercase-Is-Reserved Rule
rules.body: text-transform: uppercase applies only to: nav links, section labels (DM Mono), button text, chip labels, and column headers. H2 and H3 are title-case, no exceptions.

rules.name: The Italic-Signals-Motion Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed italic appears only on display-scale type (hero, plan names, coach names). It marks 'this is a person or a headline' — it does not apply to UI text, labels, or body copy.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces at rest have no box-shadow. Depth is conveyed by the lightness ramp and 1px micro-borders. A shadow on a card means one thing: it is the featured choice.

rules.name: The Micro-Border Rule
rules.body: Section and component separators use 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06). A 2px solid forge-orange border marks the top of the featured plan card — it replaces the 'Mais popular' badge entirely.

dos: Do use border-top: 2px solid #FF5E1A as the sole featured indicator on the plan card
Do apply DM Mono to every number: stats, prices, times, KPIs, availability counts
Do separate sections with border-top: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06) + 7.5rem vertical padding
Do keep Barlow Condensed italic for display-scale and component title-level type
Do build the hero background in CSS using radial-gradient from forge orange at 8-12% opacity
Do cap display type at clamp(3.5rem, 10vw, 6rem)
Do set border-radius: 2px on all buttons
Do position Dashboard and AreaAluno sections as product showcases before the pricing section
Do use prefers-reduced-motion on every animation
donts: Don't use clip-path: polygon() on buttons — prohibited site-wide
Don't use #E8FF00 (volt yellow) anywhere — replaced by forge orange
Don't alternate section backgrounds — one background, one separator rule
Don't use text-transform: uppercase on H2 or H3 — headers are title-case
Don't render the dashboard as a footnote — it comes before pricing
Don't use box-shadow on default-state cards — reserved for featured plan card only
Don't link to external images in CSS (remove the Unsplash URL in .hero-bg)
Don't use glassmorphism decoratively — backdrop-filter in nav bar only
Don't use #4A4D5F for body copy — fails WCAG AA at body size
Don't use gradient text (background-clip: text) — forge orange is solid
Don't use the 'big number + small label + gradient accent' hero-metric template
